Female-fronted alternative rock / hard rock with intense emotional delivery; powerful high-mid range female vocals (raw, gritty, dynamic - from whispered defiance to full-throated scream), lyrics about resistance, female empowerment, and societal rebellion; instrumentation: distorted electric guitars with heavy palm-muted riffs and soaring leads, thunderous live drums (aggressive snare, crashing cymbals), driving bassline, occasional synth texture for tension; structure: quiet-loud dynamics, explosive chorus, bridge with spoken-word buildup into final climax; mood: urgent, cathartic, defiant, cinematic; tempo: 95-110 BPM; production: modern, punchy mix with analog warmth, slight tape saturation, vocal reverb only in choruses; reference vibe: early Paramore meets Alanis Morissette with hints of Japanese all-female rock bands like BAND-MAID.
